items.title: Show HN: X402 integrations for an AI-agent data API, checked in a clean room
items.summary: I run Blockchain IQ. We sell some crypto data to software agents per request over x402 (HTTP 402, USDC on Base, no account or API key). In October we paid for integrations: 22 were submitted and we checked each one by matching its on-chain payment to our purchase log and running it in a clean temporary folder with a throwaway wallet.
